headline: Monetary Authority Of Singapore Launches Year Of The Goat Coin
seoTitle: MAS Year of the Goat Coins 2027
metaDescription: The Monetary Authority of Singapore has introduced new Year of the Goat coins featuring the Little Guilin landmark, with pre-orders open until December 13.
aiSummaryBullets: The Monetary Authority of Singapore has released commemorative coins for the 2027 Year of the Goat.
The design features Little Guilin, a well-known landmark located in Bukit Batok.
Interested collectors can submit pre-orders via the Singapore Mint through December 13, with general sales starting January 1.
aiContextParagraph: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) has unveiled its latest collection of commemorative coins marking the upcoming 2027 Year of the Goat in the Chinese zodiac. These new coins incorporate cultural themes alongside local geography, specifically showcasing the scenic Little Guilin, a granite rock formation situated within the Bukit Batok Town Park in Singapore. Following the announcement, the Singapore Mint has opened a pre-order window for the public, which runs from November 19 until December 13. Following this period, the coins are scheduled to be available for both online and in-store purchase starting January 1, 2027. This release continues the central bank's tradition of issuing zodiac-themed currency, designed to appeal to both collectors and those observing the lunar new year traditions in the region.
whyItIsViral: This release is generating moderate attention, covered by two independent news outlets and showing steady momentum through public information channels.
